description: This file provides functions to integrate React components with Playwright testing environment, including mounting, updating, and unmounting React components within a web page during tests.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Type guard function that checks if a given object is a JSX component based on the '__pw_type' property.

methods.name: __pwRender
methods.description: Renders a value, transforming JSX components into React elements using React's createElement, recursively.
